messages.text: Good to meet you — this card is in excellent condition and fills a hard-to-complete album page, so we're opening at 281. Happy to talk if you come back with a serious offer.
Happy to buy Café en Goya at 99 primas, ready to sign now.
Thanks for the quick reply, but 99 is far below what Café en Goya is worth — we've had steady interest in it today. We can move to 268 as a sign of good faith; meet us closer and we'll have a deal.
You're still sitting at 99, so we'll make another step toward you and come down to 259 for Café en Goya. Show us some movement on your side and we can close this quickly.
Thanks for moving. We can come up to 105 for Café en Goya, which is a fair price for both of us.
I can do 231. That is a fair deal for both of us.
We've come down a long way for Café en Goya while you've moved only slightly, so 222 is a generous step from our side. Bring a real counter and we can wrap this up today.
We've taken several steps toward you on Café en Goya while you've only gone from 99 to 105, so 208 is where we land this round. Match our effort with a real move and we can close this today.

Café en Goya is one of the last cards we're parting with today, and we have a cheaper buyer's stall nearby asking about it, so we'll step down to 188 to keep this between us. We've done most of the moving since your 105, so a meaningful jump from you would get this signed quickly.

We've been doing most of the walking since your 105, so we'll ease down to 164 for Café en Goya, but our steps get smaller from here. If you want this card for your collection, now is the time to meet us with a real counter.

We'll take one more small step to 140 for Café en Goya, though our purse needs a fair return on a card this rare. Your 105 is still far off, so a genuine move from you is what it takes to close this today.
Thanks for the moves. We can step up to 117 for Café en Goya and sign today.
Thanks for coming up to 117. That's a real step, so we'll meet you at 134 for Café en Goya, which is a fair landing for a card we're sad to let go.
